A '''clan''' of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] demanded that the Republic declassify files about the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], where their ancestors fought during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. With the help of an independent agent, they were able to convince the Republic to release the files.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Dxun's Lost Warriors}}</ref>
